summary: Add the private TypeScript authoring package `fractal` (packages/fractal): agents, missions and schedules as path-named modules rendered to native KDL; the user guide's TS samples use it

replay.detail: No receipt, replay or historical interpretation changes; the package only renders KDL that the existing parser reads.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, migrations or claim kinds change.

compatibility.detail: No daemon, client, wire, CLI or KDL contract change. The package is a private workspace member, not published to npm. Its rendered KDL parses to the same declarations and mission revisions as the hand-written forms it replaces in the docs; documented mission samples now name a report-to agent, which the package requires.

manual.detail: No manual step. Consumers of genie-fractal can switch imports to fractal, fractal/tree and fractal/testing when they choose.

recovery.detail: No persistent state; reverting the package and docs needs no recovery action.
